verdict.rationale: Granola Chat is a built-in AI assistant. Per its docs, it can complete post-meeting work such as drafting and sending follow-up emails, sending Slack messages, and creating Google Calendar events, with a review step before anything is sent. Users can also save prompts as one-click recipes and query across meetings or folders. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that chat delegation works as described, and evidence of delegable actions beyond the few documented email/Slack/calendar workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Granola Chat can help you complete the work that comes after a meeting, without switching between your notes and other apps.
Ask Chat to: draft and send a follow-up email * draft and send a Slack message * find a time and create a Google Calendar event
Use Granola Chat to draft follow-up emails, send Slack messages, and schedule Google Calendar events — with a review step before anything is sent or created.
you can save your favorite prompts as recipes and run them with a single click.
